assertion: External fragments reuse shapes, inherited styles, gradients, clipping and patterns with isolated document IDs. Missing references and cycles are errors; loading is independent of frame time.

browser.reason: Reviewed all three browsers. Chromium preserves the referenced elements stylesheet declarations on use instances, as SVG 1.1 requires; Firefox and WebKit omit the external class stroke here. All three agree on the external gradient, clip and pattern geometry. Native differences are confined to 3285 gradient pixels with a one-level channel rounding difference; reviewed actual and difference images.
